svg.text: Paystack: outbound GTM system, end to end
svg.textArea: Illustrative bootcamp design, not an official Paystack system. Source: context/docs/gtm-system.md. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Route, find people, write the message

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, facts

1B Buying signals
• FCCPC new lenders
• Hiring abroad
• Payments hiring
• New betting licences
• Funded + competitor

1C Find companies
Signal first, match name to website

1D Enrich accounts
Industry, headcount, funding, gateway, jobs

1E ICP fit gates
• Registered in Nigeria
• Not a Paystack merchant
• Not a competitor
• Takes digital payments
• Tier 1 or 2 vertical
• Size rule

1J Corporates and government
Account-based list for sales

2B Displacement path
Competitor gateway script on site

2D Product angle
• Recurring: Subscriptions
• Payouts: Transfers
• Splits: Subaccounts
• KYC: Identity
• Else: Collections

2E Find people
Champion first, finance lead later. Max 2 per account

2F Find and verify email
Provider waterfall, then verify

2I Write the copy
Workflow spec, then copy from approved facts only

3A Send the sequence
3 emails + 2 LinkedIn DMs. Any reply stops both

3C Pipeline
• Engaged
• Meeting booked
• Opportunity
• Won or lost, with reason

3D Weekly review
Replies, meetings, fit fails, objections, bounces by signal and persona
Weekly loop: learnings update icp.md, signal-matrix.md and facts.md
